facts.statement: Standalone Net Sales growth was about 2.9% for Q3.
facts.quote: If you see that the Net Sales growth is about 2.9%, I think a little bit lower here because of the festive season being cut short.

facts.statement: Volume growth for Q3 was strong at almost about 8%.
facts.quote: But, the volume growth has been strong at almost about 8%.

facts.statement: Standalone Gross Margin for Q3 was registered at about 44.9%.
facts.quote: about 44.9%, 200 bps points higher, and I think other than the deflation, we have also seen a lot of efficiencies in terms of the cost

facts.statement: PBDIT margin for Q3 stood at 21.4%, which is 100 bps up yoy.
facts.quote: and the PBDIT margins are also quite good at 21.4%, 100 bps up yoy.

facts.statement: Consolidated Gross Margin is 44.3% which is higher by about 200 bps points.
